result_evidence: The outside-candidate oracle returned QUALIFIED for the corrected candidate with all ten predicates observed-good, and every baseline and red control behaved as specified - but the required assignment-distinct adjudication never returned a verdict, and the effective effort actually in force on the maker invocation was not observed. Both are required by this contract, so the reusable result is missing evidence rather than a pass.

adjudication.evidence: data/sol-high-runtime-maker-qualification-review/ holds the assignment-distinct evaluator's instructions and no report; the evaluator binding first attempted for that role returned FAILED on qualification-evidence-v1 for emitting non-canonical result and observation values, recorded at data/luna-qualification-evidence-adjudicator/report.md.

freshness_dependencies.justification: Three declared dependencies are uncovered - harness semantics, provider-side binding semantics, and the native effort mapping - so this observation is bounded in time instead. The bound is one month from the observation date, which is the monthly evidence-review cadence the model-onboarding observation levels already declare for a routed model at O3: the shortest interval at which this fleet already commits to re-reading a routed model's evidence. A shorter bound would expire before the evidence could be reused at all; a longer one would outlive a harness upgrade nothing here can see.

known_limitations: The fixture measures the named reusable runtime-maker contract, not arbitrary production runtime competence.
The oracle's QUALIFIED output on the corrected candidate is maker evidence and is not assignment-distinct adjudication; this record does not treat it as one.
Context use was not exposed by this runtime and is recorded as could-not-observe rather than estimated.
The provider exposed no server-side model snapshot identifier beyond the installed binding name.

The effective effort actually in force on the maker invocation was not observed, and neither a requested flag, a reasoning-token count, answer correctness, nor a separate preflight invocation was accepted as a substitute for it.
One correction-runner source failed to parse before executing any statement or writing either candidate file; it is retained as observed-bad evidence rather than hidden.
The bounded run establishes nothing about future provider availability or sustained concurrency.
No fleet-declared verifier exists for local qualification semantics, so the deterministic fixture oracle is the evidence owner and the result is classified by hand under the three-valued rule.
note: The first real record in this register, and it is deliberately not a pass. Recording the honest QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED is what makes the register worth reading: this exact tuple stays excluded from a route that requires this contract, the search for another binding is lawful engineering rather than a captain exception, and nothing about this binding is written as a failure or as a reputation. Re-running or relabelling this qualification is out of scope until a same-invocation effort observation mechanism exists; that is the governing ruling's instruction, not this file's preference.
